fields.statement: At b0b8e269 I ran go test -trimpath -count=1 -run TestScheduleDue -v ./internal/daemon (4 tests PASS) and the whole internal/daemon package (ok); go vet and gofmt clean. Read internal/daemon/scheduledue.go and its tests: ScheduleDue is pure over dispatch.Schedule, schedule.Schedule, a journal-derived ScheduleState and now. Tests cover each acceptance point: TestScheduleDueOnTime (10:00 slot fires at 10:00, not at 9:59); TestScheduleDueMissedSlots (slots 2,3,4 missed fire once for 4:00 under catch_up once, a follow-up decision is quiet, none under catch_up skip with next 5:00); TestScheduleDueNewSchedule (Since 9:30 no fire at 9:45, fires 10:00); TestScheduleDueOverlap (no fire while running; after the run ends at 11:20 the 10:00 and 11:00 slots are dropped under overlap skip and fire once for 11:00 under queue, quiet after that run is journaled).
